name: Loot Table
description: Weighted random drop table that grants items into a target inventory on trigger.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

inputs.name: entries
inputs.description: List of {from, items} — what falls out of a kind of thing. `from` is the `kind` a combat.hit carries for a harvestable prop, or the `kind` inventory.containerOpened carries for a chest; an entry with no `from` answers for everything. A unit's drop is its defeat, which is inventory.affix_loot_generator's business — it asks this table WHAT through `pick`.
